art.title: Mother and Child in White
art.why: The spec's alternative to Cain and Abel: a mother holding her child securely, for the sanctity of every life. Plain and unsentimental.

art.title: The Church of Souain
art.why: A ruined church on the Western Front, painted in 1917 ('F. VALLOTTON. 17.'): war's cost without glory, as the spec asks. That Souain is in Champagne and was destroyed in the war is outside knowledge: PLEASE CHECK before saying it.

art.title: The Visitation with Saint Nicholas and Saint Anthony Abbot
art.why: REUSE of an existing art id: the only NGA Visitation, and the exact subject (Luke 1:41, the unborn John leaping).

art.title: The Death of Saint Clare
art.why: REUSE, candidate only: no free NGA painting of a nurse at a bedside (Chardin is used); a dying woman attended by her sisters is the nearest real subject. Drafter: read its description first; if it does not show care for the dying, use null.

music.why: Lyte wrote it as he was dying: the end of life faced with trust, not control.
